name: Ring of Selective Vision
body:
Aura faint divination; CL 4th; Slot ring; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This ring appears to be a ring of far sight and functions as such. The wearer, however, becomes focused on his intended opponent, losing track of other opponents. As a result, the wearer is considered flat-footed for any attacks made against him by opponents other than the last opponent he attacked.

This ring can only be removed by the casting of remove curse upon it. In this event, the ring may be removed but the ring and enchantment remain intact.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Magic Items ring of far sight

Identification DC 29
False Identification DC 19
